shelters.name: Associated Humane Societies
shelters.description: Founded 1906, New Jersey's First Animal Shelter and largest sheltering system. Over 100 years of service with three shelters in Newark, Forked River, and Tinton Falls.

shelters.name: St. Hubert's Animal Welfare Center
shelters.description: Dedicated to humane treatment of animals. All animals examined, temperament assessed, vaccinated, dewormed, microchipped, and spayed/neutered before release.

shelters.name: Animal Welfare Association
shelters.description: South New Jersey's oldest and largest no-kill shelter and low-cost veterinary clinic. AWA Pet Clinic provides low-cost vaccinations, spay/neuter, and wellness services.

shelters.name: NJ Humane Society
shelters.description: No-kill shelter serving Hudson County and Northern New Jersey. Mission to protect and rescue stray and domesticated animals.

shelters.name: Monmouth County SPCA
shelters.description: SPCA serving Monmouth County with adoption services, rescue, and animal welfare programs.

shelters.name: Bergen County SPCA
shelters.description: Addresses animal cruelty in Bergen County's 250 square miles and 70 municipalities. Promotes responsible pet ownership and accessible veterinary services.

shelters.name: Ramapo-Bergen Animal Refuge
shelters.description: Bergen County's only nonprofit, no-kill shelter. Protects abandoned, abused, and unwanted animals by finding loving homes and providing food, shelter, and medical treatment.

shelters.name: Liberty Humane Society
shelters.description: Provides shelter, medical care, and adoption services for homeless animals. Promotes responsible pet ownership through community education.

shelters.name: Secaucus Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Rescues abandoned, abused and injured animals; rehabilitates them; vaccinates, spays/neuters; and finds them loving adoptive homes.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Bergen County
shelters.description: Providing care to all animals since 1972. Houses dogs, cats, birds, and other wildlife.

shelters.name: Animal Protection League of NJ
shelters.description: Animal rescue and protection organization serving Northern New Jersey.

shelters.name: Jersey Shore Animal Center
shelters.description: Animal shelter supporting animals in need along the Jersey Shore and Ocean County area.

shelters.name: NJSPCA
shelters.description: Created 1868, second oldest SPCA in the country. Law Enforcement Officers investigate and prosecute animal abuse and neglect statewide.

shelters.name: All About Animals NJ
shelters.description: Nonprofit animal rescue in Ocean County helping pets find forever homes, assisting unwanted cats and dogs.

shelters.name: Homeward Bound Pet Adoption Center
shelters.description: Pet adoption center serving South Jersey with rescue, adoption, and community programs.

notes: Comprehensive collection of New Jersey animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Associated Humane Societies (founded 1906) is NJ's first and largest shelter system. NJSPCA (created 1868) is the second oldest in the country. Coverage spans Newark, Jersey City, Bergen County, Monmouth County, Ocean County, and South Jersey.
